offering_description.value: Etsy operates an online marketplace where independent sellers offer handmade, custom, and vintage goods and craft supplies to consumers. It connects buyers and sellers through its website and mobile apps and provides sellers with payment processing, advertising, and shipping tools.

primary_services.value: online marketplace listings and sales; payment processing; seller advertising; shipping label sales; seller subscription tools

customer_segment.value: B2C: Shoppers looking for gifts, personalized items, vintage goods, and craft supplies; B2B: Independent makers, designers, vintage merchants, and craft supply sellers

end_markets.value: gifts and personalized goods; home and living; jewelry and accessories; apparel; arts and crafts

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Listing items, completing marketplace sales, and processing payments; advertising: Promoted listings and sales attributed to offsite ads; service fees: Shipping labels purchased by sellers; subscription: Optional paid seller plans with listing and shop tools
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; advertising; service fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Aggregates listings from independent merchants and connects them with shoppers; service provider: Processes buyer payments for merchants and offers sellers advertising and shipping tools

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, continental Europe, Australia, and other markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: Marketplace for handmade, custom, and vintage goods and craft supplies, with services for sellers

distribution_channels.value: online: Company-operated marketplace website and mobile apps

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Online marketplace operations subject to consumer protection, marketplace tax rules, the EU Digital Services Act, and GDPR

notes: I assumed the announced Depop sale had closed by November 2026.
